# netbox_location (Data Source)

Retrieves a single location from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_location" "example" {
  name = "Server room"
  site_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the location.
- `name` (String) The name of the location.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the location.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the location.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the location.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the location.
- `status` (String) The status of the location.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the location.
